name: souroldgeezer-tabletop
description: Claude Code plugins by Sour Old Geezer for tabletop roleplaying simulation: seeded, deterministic rules engines exposed over MCP, with the skills that drive them.

plugins.name: fivee-sim
plugins.description: 5E-compatible combat simulation over a single seeded rules kernel. Stateful encounters the engine owns and Claude narrates, plus Monte Carlo damage and win-rate analytics replayed through the same stepper, so the statistics can never drift from the rules live play uses. Covers weapon attacks, movement and reactions, conditions, and a curated spell set with saves, areas, and concentration.
